title: NSPanel: Fleet & Manager
description: Fleet health from NSPanelManager's /prometheus/metrics, plus the manager's own MQTT, integrations and process metrics.

panels.title: Panels online
panels.description: Accepted panels the manager sees as ONLINE.

panels.title: Behind staged firmware
panels.description: Panels that are up and whose running sonoff firmware md5 differs from the manager's staged image.

targets.expr: count((max by (panel, md5_firmware) (nspm_panel_info{model="sonoff"}) unless on(md5_firmware) label_replace(nspm_staged_image_info{type="firmware",variant="sonoff"}, "md5_firmware", "$1", "md5", "(.*)")) and on(panel) (max by (panel) (nspm_panel_up) == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Panels with updates pending
panels.description: Panels with at least one image (firmware, LittleFS or TFT) the manager says is newer than what the panel runs.

panels.title: Panel up
panels.description: nspm_panel_up from the manager: 1 while online or updating, 0 while waiting, rebooting or offline.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: One row per panel. 'Metrics' = the panel's own /metrics is being scraped (metrics firmware).

targets.expr: max by (panel, ip, md5_firmware, md5_littlefs, md5_tft) (nspm_panel_info)

panels.title: Wi-Fi signal (RSSI)
panels.description: From each panel's status report (works on any firmware). Below −80 dBm is marginal.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Panel temperature sensor, converted to °C by the manager.

panels.title: Status report age
panels.description: Worst seconds-since-last-status-report in each 5 min window. A panel that is 'up' but stops reporting shows here first.

panels.title: Panel warnings and errors (log lines/min)
panels.description: Warning + error log lines each panel sends to the manager, per minute.

panels.title: Configs sent (per hour, by reason)
panels.description: reload_resend is the duplicate send after every reload (see FIXES_PENDING.md).

panels.title: Dropped messages (24h)
panels.description: Messages lost because the processing queue was full.

panels.title: Queue depth (max)
panels.description: Highest processing-queue depth since the manager started (capacity 256).

panels.title: Queue wait p95 by topic class
panels.description: Time a received message waits before it's processed. Builds whose processing thread polls the queue every 100 ms show waits spread evenly over 0–100 ms; with the thread woken on push (fix/mqtt-queue-wakeup) they should be well under 1 ms.

panels.title: Handler time p95 by topic class
Queue full: subscribe-path waits & drops (per minute)
Time blocked on a full queue (s/min)
panels.description: Seconds per minute the subscribe path spent waiting for room in the processing queue.

panels.title: Home Assistant
panels.description: WebSocket connection (nspm_home_assistant_connected) plus authentication (nspm_home_assistant_authenticated).

panels.title: OpenHAB
panels.description: Only meaningful if OpenHAB is configured.

panels.title: Home Assistant call latency p95 by domain
panels.description: call_service sent → result received.

panels.title: Home Assistant call failures/min by domain
Home Assistant state changes/s by domain
Panel command → integration call, p95
panels.description: From a panel command arriving to the first HA/OpenHAB call it makes.

panels.title: Integration messages/s
panels.description: HA received is dominated by state_changed events for every entity in HA, not only the ones panels use.

panels.title: Status reports/min by panel
panels.description: About 2/min normally (every 30 s); faster during updates (every 1–5 s).

panels.title: Update progress
panels.description: Only panels with an update in progress are drawn.

panels.title: Register requests (per hour)
panels.description: A panel sends register_request when it boots, so this is effectively a reboot count.

panels.title: Weather data age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful weather fetch.

panels.title: Clock broadcasts (per hour)
panels.description: Wall-clock time the manager publishes to panels (about once a minute).
